answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, drying like yarrow in a parched canyon. A fake farm can bloom across the orchard for a moment, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding labor bill they cannot sustain.
